decanoFacultad.deleted: Decano assignment for user {{ login }} was removed.

delete.question: Remove the dean assignment of {{ login }} in faculty {{ facultad }}? (For corrections only. Use "Close term" for the formal change.)

asignar.title: Assign dean to faculty
asignar.body: Register an active dean assignment for a faculty. Use the user login (must have ROLE_DECANO). If the faculty already has an active dean, first use the row's Close term button with its until date, then create the new one.
asignar.loginResolved: User found: {{ nombre }}. ROLE_DECANO was validated.
asignar.loginNotFound: No user exists with that login.
asignar.loginMissingDecanoRole: User exists but does not have ROLE_DECANO. Assign the role before registering as dean.
asignar.invalidForm: Fill in login, faculty and from date before assigning.
asignar.facultadesLoadError: Could not load the faculty list. Check your connection and try again.
asignar.noticeSuccess: Dean {{ login }} assigned to faculty {{ facultad }}.

cerrar.title: Close term of {{ login }}
cerrar.body: This closes the active assignment of dean {{ login }}. The row keeps its data and the until date; the historic is preserved. After closing you can assign a new dean from the main form.
cerrar.facultadNoEncontrada: Could not identify the faculty of the dean.
cerrar.noticeSuccess: Term of {{ login }} closed on {{ fecha }}.
